note: Draft list of named scenes. Each url is a playground link (the query string is the state from urlState.ts); edit it as data. The hull and the lit lines are not in the URL yet, so a scene opens on the playground's default hull; the description says which look it stands for.

scenes.name: ahead-all-round
scenes.description: Dead ahead at half a mile: both sidelights and the masthead light, full strength.

scenes.name: sidelight-edge-112-5
scenes.description: Power vessel at 112.5 degrees, the aft edge of the sidelight sector: the side light is about to drop out.

scenes.name: masthead-edge-225
scenes.description: Power vessel at 225 degrees, the aft edge of the masthead light's arc: only the stern light is left.

scenes.name: stern-dead-astern
scenes.description: Dead astern at half a mile: the stern light alone.

scenes.name: abeam-starboard
scenes.description: Abeam to starboard: green side light and masthead light.

scenes.name: abeam-port
scenes.description: Abeam to port: red side light and masthead light.

scenes.name: sidelight-range-dropout
scenes.description: Sidelight at the edge of its range: the side light fades while the masthead light still carries.

scenes.name: all-lights-lost-far
scenes.description: Four and a half miles off: every light past its range, only the masthead glow is left to see.

scenes.name: single-lantern-ahead
scenes.description: Dead ahead with the combined lantern (one lamp for both side lights) instead of two.

scenes.name: day-bearing-view
scenes.description: Daylight, bearing view at 45 degrees: the hull shape with no lights doing the work.

scenes.name: night-silhouette-soft
scenes.description: Night silhouette, soft style, 135 degrees: the hull as a shape against the water.

scenes.name: profile-with-glow
scenes.description: Profile view abeam with the range glow on: how far each light reaches.
